items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch (objection) against the contribution notice
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe
items.computation: Sender is a public-law health insurer (Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts), so social-law deemed-delivery rules (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) apply to the posted letter dated Thu 21.05.2026: it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 25.05.2026 (this day does not shift for social-law letters even though it is Pfingstmontag, a public holiday). Under § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts running 26.05.2026 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. Thu 25.06.2026. That day is a normal working day in NRW, so no further shift applies.

items.title: First monthly contribution collected by direct debit (SEPA-Lastschrift)
items.quote: Die Beiträge werden jeweils zum 15. des Folgemonats per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: Membership and contribution liability start 01.06.2026. Contributions are collected on the 15th of the month following the month they relate to, so the first collection (for June 2026) falls due on 15.07.2026. 15 July 2026 is a Wednesday, a normal working day, so no weekend/holiday shift is needed. This is a recurring monthly obligation; only the first due date is given, later ones follow the same 15th-of-following-month pattern.
